start_here: Say to your AI: "Show my cost measurements", with {"store":{"where":"postgresql database measurements on my own computer","language":"SQL (PostgreSQL)","credential_name":"measurements-postgres-connection"}}. It runs workflow:read-cost-measurements, gives the rows it reads to tool:measurement-workspace as its measurements input, and the screen opens at /lists/cost-measurements
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: the measurement rows are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:read-cost-measurements" with store and, when you want fewer than all three, kinds (observations, forecasts, billing).

3. The first run makes the store's own measurement rows once, if the store keeps none, and proves the read on the example rows: every answer must be the one the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Give the records the workflow read back to tool:measurement-workspace as its measurements input, with complete. The screen shows Coverage as unknown until every page was read.

worked_examples.title: Read the cost measurements of a store

store.where: postgresql database measurements on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The look step found the measurement rows the store keeps: three observation rows, one forecast version and one billing record.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answered {"records": {"observations": [...], "forecasts": [...], "billing": [...]}, "complete": true}; those values go to tool:measurement-workspace as its measurements input.
